text: Short-term courses which are open in July and August run from three to six weeks each, with a total of 24 class hours per week. Depending on the students’ needs and their level of proficiency in Chinese, the courses may include comprehensive Chinese, intensive Chinese listening , oral Chinese practice , and Chinese reading. During the courses, extra curriculum activities such as sightseeing tours and other excursions are organized so as to help students get to know more about Chinese customs and have direct contact with the Chinese society.
